title: Image management is tedious
summary: It only operates on one page worth of images, there is no immediately apparent way of showing untagged images and there is no indicator of how many images (or pages) there are. This makes it rather tedious to delete stale or unused images. What's really needed is a image lifecycle policy feature that would let me specify somthing like "automatically delete untagged index images and the images they refer to if all underlying (non-index) images were last pulled more than a month ago"

title: Workaround busybox?
summary: Hi, Apologies for the not-so-well-worded question. I am using the extension for SSH connections. On my host machine, the following command works. ``` readlink -e . ``` Whereas using the integrated terminal on the ssh-ed machine, I get ``` $ readlink -e . readlink: unrecognized option: e BusyBox v1.37.0 (2026-01-10 15:38:28 UTC) multi-call binary. Usage: readlink [-fnv] FILE Display the value of a symlink -n Don't add newline -f Canonicalize by following all symlinks -v Verbose ``` This actually breaks the scripts that I do not own but need to source. Just wanted to check if I can work around this? Maybe not have busybox installation? Thank you.
